note.p: As Ed Pope notes, we have good grounds for thinking that the Miss Collins and E Collins entries between 1817 and 1827, refer to the same or closely related person, but we have thus far failed to identify which person(s) it is: "I have left aside for now the forty or so Collins entries between 1817 and 1827, all but the first one were miss Collins or E Collins (who were probably one person). The miss Collins at Rowan's above could have been the same person but there was a gap of eleven years. Meanwhile I have no idea yet who either of the two above were either See Ed Pope's comment: I have left aside for now the forty or so Collins entries between 1817 and 1827, all but the first one were miss Collins or E Collins (who were probably one person). The miss Collins at Rowan's in 1801 and 1806 could have been the same person but there was a gap of eleven years. Meanwhile I have no idea yet who either of the two above were either."
